terms.comment: Greek κατήχησις, instruction by word of mouth: Jerome’s word for religious instruction (Lewis & Short); to teach it is catēchīzāre (Tert.). Children’s classes in the faith, often on Sunday after the service, in the Orthodox and the Western churches alike.
The English rendered word for word, after diēs Dominicus, Sunday.

sources: Lewis & Short: catechesis · Lewis & Short: catechizo · Lewis & Short: schola · Lewis & Short: dominicus
Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for Sunday school; Levi–Bini gives only catechismo, catēchismus (p. 14).
